# DSA-MUN

> DSA-MUN is Greece's premier Model United Nations conference, offering delegates comprehensive preparation, committee-specific training, and an immersive diplomatic experience.

DSA-MUN (Delphi Summer Academy Model United Nations) is an annual international conference bringing together student delegates to simulate UN proceedings. The organization provides extensive educational resources, committee manuals, and logistical support for participants from around the world.

## Key Topics

- Model United Nations
- 29th Conference 2026
